limitations: No local questionnaire or official dictionary available in inspected repository. Code meanings and skip logic remain unresolved.
Employment filter is absent from SCIENTIFIC_PROTOCOL.md; all subgroup counts precede employment selection.
Empty strings and repeated-nine tokens are observed representations, not assigned missing-value semantics.

Hour-minute candidates beyond contract fields are inferred from naming and require dictionary validation. Arithmetic validity is not semantic validity. The 120-hour flag is a review threshold, not a cleaning rule; weekend-specific bounds are not imposed.
FAC_PER sums are descriptive positive-weight sums; not validated employed-population estimates. FAC_HOG is not substituted for a person weight.
Self-care, family interaction and leisure mappings, working-time covariates and children definitions require approval.
No pipeline modified or built; pipeline validity is not asserted.
